decision.functionalVariant: Retain shipped native entry/procedure variant as the supported functional baseline.
decision.optimization: No execution-speed or monetary-cost optimization is accepted from this small host-constrained comparison. Both arms retain real permission stops; failed samples are not removed or retried into the comparison.
decision.context: Entry-word counts measure the entry only; each high-risk workflow still reads its own procedure and shared contract. Do not equate entry reduction with total context or runtime savings.
decision.claude: Separately recorded actual default-Claude lifecycle and clean fixture gate; no cross-runtime performance inference.
